title: Cultural Conditioning or Placebo? On the Effectiveness of Socio-Demographic Prompting
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not specifically measure faith or religion. Its focus is on the placebo effect of socio-demographic prompting using cultural (e.g., country, food) and non-cultural (e.g., house number, planet) proxies on both culturally sensitive and neutral datasets.
findings: The paper does not provide any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
